sa: तत्र राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा विप्रास्ते भरतर्षभ। नियता वाग्यताश्चैव पावकं शरणं ययुः॥
en: Then hearing the king's words, O foremost prince of Bharata's race, the Brahmanas, controlling speech, sought with concentrated faculties the help of the god of fire.

sa: तत्त्वानि च चतुर्विंशत् परिसंख्याय तत्त्वतः। सांख्याः सह प्रकृत्या तु निस्तत्त्वः पञ्चविंशकः॥
en: Rightly studying the twenty-four topics along with Nature, and determining their true nature, the Sankhyas succeed in seeing. That which is the twenty-four topics or principles.

sa: चेतनेन समेतस्य पञ्चविंशतिकस्य ह। एकत्वं वै भवत्यस्य यदा बुद्ध्या न बुध्यते॥
en: When Individual Soul, who is endued with consciousness, loses all Consciousness of a distinct or individual self, then does he, losing his multifariousness, resume his Oneness.

sa: व्यास उवाच धर्मं पुत्र निषेवस्व सुतीक्ष्णौ च हिमातपौ। क्षुत्पिपासे च वायुंच जय नित्यं जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Vyasa said O son, becoming the master of your senses, do you conquer extreme cold and extreme heat, hunger and thirst, and the wind also, and having controlled them, do you practise virtue.

sa: स निश्चयमथो कृत्वा पूजयामास देवताः। भक्त्या न चैवाध्यगच्छद् धनं सम्पूज्य देवताः॥
en: Determined to achieve his object, he began to adore the gods with great devotion. But he failed to acquire riches by such adoration of the gods.

sa: ये परस्वापहर्तारः परस्वानां च नाशकाः। सूचकाश्च परेषां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who rob others of their riches or destroy the riches and properties of other people, or trumpet the shortcomings of other people, sink in hell.

sa: ततः स प्राद्रवद् विप्रो विस्मयाद् विगलक्लमः। गौतमः परमधिं तां पश्यन् परमविस्मितः॥
en: Thus accosted, the Brahmana, forgetting is exhaustion in his surprise, ran with the messengers. Seeing the great prosperity of the city, he was filled with wonder.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः स विदितो राज्ञः प्रविश्य गृहमुत्तमम्। पूजितो राक्षसेन्द्रेण निषसादासनोत्तमे॥
en: Bhishma said Conducted into a spacious apartment, Gautama was introduced to the king of the Rakshasas. Adored by the latter, he sat on an excellent seat.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि नारदेनानुकीर्तितम्। उच्छवृत्तेः पुरावृत्तं यज्ञा ब्राह्मणस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it I shall relate to you the history, formerly recited by Narada, of a Brahmana who for celebrating sacrifices, lived like a beggar.

sa: कं वा कामं ददाम्यद्य ब्रूहि यद् वत्स काङ्क्षसे। प्राञ्जलिः स उवाचेदं त्वयि भक्तिर्दृढास्तु मे॥
en: What wishes of yours shall I grant today? Tell me, O son, what do you seek. At this, Tandi Joined his hands and said O Lord, let my devotion to you be steady.

sa: पल्वलानि च सर्वाणि सर्वं चैव तृणोपलम्। स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्॥ तदेतद् भस्मसाद्भूतं जगत् सर्वमुपल्लुतम्। प्रसीद भगवन् साधो वर एष वृतो मया॥
en: All tanks, all sorts of grass and herbs, all immobile beings, and all the four divisions of mobile creatures, are being consumed. The whole universe is about to be shorn of beings. Be pleased, O divine Lord! O you of pious soul this is the boon that I seek at your hands.

sa: तस्य पुत्रो हरि म नारायणसमो बले। स शत्रुभिर्हतः संख्ये सबलः सपदानुगः॥
en: His son, named Hari, who was like Narayana himself in strength, was in that battle killed by his enemies along with all his followers and troops.

sa: परां च प्रीतिमगमदुत्स्मयंश्च पिनाकधृक्। अवाप च तदा भागं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मणा भवः॥
en: Indeed, the holder of Pinaka, viz., Bhava, smiled and became filled with joy. And he accepted the share that the Grandfather settled the offerings in sacrifices.

sa: ज्वरं च सर्वधर्मज्ञो बहुधा व्यसृजत् तदा। शान्त्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां शृणु तच्चापि पुत्रक॥
en: Knowing the constituents of everything, Mahadeva then divided. Fever into many parts, for the peace of all creatures. Listen, O son, as how he did this.

sa: ततः शरौघैः प्रदिशो दिशश्च रवेः प्रभा कर्णरथश्च राजन्। अदृश्यमासीत् कुपिते धनंजये तुषारनीहारवृत्तं यथा नभः॥
en: O monarch, Dhananjaya, becoming angry, by his arrows covered all the sides of Karna's car; even the rays of the sun became invisible and the sky looked hazy as in a frosty day.

sa: मुनिरुवाच अथ चेत् पौरुषं किंचित् क्षत्रियात्मनि पश्यसि। ब्रवीमि तां तु ते नीति राज्यस्य प्रतिपत्तये।।।।
en: If, on the other hand, O Kshatriya, you think that you still possess any prowess, I shall describe to you about that line of policy which you may follow for recovering your kingdom.

sa: गम्भीरशब्दाश्च महास्वनाश्च शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च नदन्ति यत्र। युयुत्सवश्चाप्रतीपा भवन्ति जयस्यैतद् भाविनो रूपमाहुः॥
en: The conchs and drums blown and beat, send forth loud and deep peals. The warriors become filled with confidence. These are the marks of future success.

sa: शुशर्माणं रणे हत्वा पुत्रानस्य महारथान्॥ सप्त चाष्टौ च त्रिंशच्च सायकैरनयत् क्षमम्।
en: Having killed Susharman in that battle, Partha then, with his arrow, killed the five and thirty sons of that king, all of whom were great car-warriors.

sa: ततोऽस्य प्रहसन् क्रुद्धः शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥ क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतः प्रापतद् भुवि।
en: Filled with rage, the son of Pandu, smiling, cut off his antagonist's head with a sharp razorheaded arrow. The prince fell down dead on the earth.

sa: यस्य स्म संग्रामगता यशो वै मन्ति शत्रवः। तदसह्यतरं दुःखमहं मन्ये वधादपि॥
en: When enemies, coming to battle spoil the fame of a person, the misery the latter feels is more piercing, I think, than that of death itself.

sa: परस्परभयादेके पापाः पापं न कुर्वते। एवं सांसिद्धिके लोके सर्वं दण्डे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Another class of persons refrain from committing sinful acts through fear of society. Thus, O king, in this world, everything depends on the rod of chastisement.

sa: नाघ्नतः कीर्तिरस्तीह न वित्तं न पुनः प्रजाः। इन्द्रो वृत्रवधेनैव महेन्द्रः समपद्यत॥
en: Without slaughter no man has been able to acquire fame in this world or wealth or subjects. Indra himself, by killing Vritra, became the great Indra.

sa: पञ्चैव हि सुता देवि भविष्यन्ति तव ध्रुवाः॥ सार्जुना वा हते कर्णे सकर्णा वा हतेऽर्जुने।
en: Forsooth, O goddess, you will always have five sons! If Karna be killed with Arjuna, You will have five! If, on the other hand, Arjuna be killed, You will have five, with me.'

sa: पृथाया न कृतः कामस्तेन चापि महात्मना॥ अपि पश्चादिदं मातर्यवोचदिति नः श्रुतम्।
en: That illustrious hero, however, refused to satisfy Pritha's desire. Subsequently, we are informed, he said to his mother these words:न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं त्यत्वें नृपं दुर्योधनं रणे॥

sa: एवं शप्तस्तव भ्राता बहुभिश्चापि वञ्चितः। न शोच्यः पुरुषव्याघ्र युद्धेन निधनं गतः॥
en: Thus had your brother been cursed and beguiled by many! As, however, he has fallen in battle, you should not grieve for that foremost of man.

sa: स चिन्तयामास तदा स्तैन्यं कार्यमितो मया। न हीदानीमुपायो मे विद्यते प्राणधारणे॥
en: The sage thought and decided that he should steal that meat. And he said to himself, I have no means now of keeping up my life.

sa: ते वर्म भित्वा पुरुषोत्तमस्य सुवर्णचित्रा न्यपतन् सुमुक्ताः। वेगेन गामाविविशुः सुवेगाः स्नात्वा च कर्णाभिमुखाः प्रतीयुः॥
en: Those well-directed and mighty shafts, winged with gold, after piercing the armour of that noblest of human beings, entered the earth and having bathed (in the water of Bhogavati) again return towards Karna.

sa: न वक्ष्यामि न वक्ष्यामीत्येवं मे मनसि स्थितम्। अतिदुःखात्तु वक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध जनाधिप॥
en: I had wished not to say anything. Excited, however, by great grief I am compelled to say something. Listen to these words of mine, O king.

sa: स सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य दिशो विशून्या भयावदीणैः कुरुभिर्विहीनः। न विव्यथे भारत तत्र कर्णः प्रहृष्ट एवार्जुनमभ्यधावत्॥
en: But the great warrior Karna, O King, seeing himself abandoned on all sides and left alone, was not at all afraid but pushed on against Arjuna with a brave heart and with energy.

sa: यः स वीरो महेष्वासो रथयूथपयूथपः॥ अर्जुनेनं जित: संख्ये वीरलक्षणलक्षितः। यं सूतपुत्रं मन्यध्वं राधेयमिति पाण्डवाः॥ यो व्यराजच भूमध्ये दिवाकर इव प्रभुः। प्रत्ययुध्यत वः सर्वान् पुरा यः सपदानुगान्॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं यः प्रकर्षन् व्यरोचत। यस्य नास्ति समो वीर्ये पृथिव्यामपि पार्थिवः॥ योऽवृणीत यशः शूरः प्राणैरपि सदा भुवि। कर्णस्य सत्यसंधस्य संग्रामेष्वपलायिनः॥ कुरुध्वमुदकं तस्य भ्रातुरकिष्टकर्मणः। स हि वः पूर्वजो भ्राता भास्करान्मय्यजायत॥ कुण्डली कवची शूरो दिवाकरसमप्रभः।
en: That hero and great bowman, that chief of many car-divisions, that heroic warrior who has been killed by Arjuna in battle, that warrior whom, ye sons of Pandu, you knew as the son of the charioteer Radha, that hero who shone in the midst of his army like the Sun himself, who fought with all of you and your followers, who shone as he commanded the vast army of Duryodhana, who had no equal on Earth in energy, that hero who preferred glory to life, that brave warrior firm in truth and never fatigued with exertion, was your eldest brother! Offer oblations of water to that eldest brother of yours who was born of me by the Sun! That hero was born with a pair of earrings and clad in armour, and took after the Sun-God himself in effulgence.

sa: ते तत्र धिष्ठितास्तेषां सर्वं तद् वचनं रहः। दुर्योधनवचश्चैव शुश्रुवुः संगता मिथः॥
en: As they sat concealed on the banks of that lake, those men heard every word of that conversation that took place between "Duryodhana and those warriors.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच केन ज्ञानबलेनैवं पुत्र पश्यसि सिद्धवत्। तन्मे वद महाबाहो श्रोतव्यं यदि वै मया॥
en: Dhritarashtra said By what knowledge, O son, you see these things like one crowned with ascetic success? Tell me this, O mighty-armed one, if you think that I can listen to it properly!'

sa: अथाब्रवीत् क्रोधसंरक्तनेत्रो मद्राधिपं सूतपुत्रस्तरस्वी। न संधत्ते द्विः शरं शल्य को न मादृशा जिह्ययुद्धा भवन्ति॥
en: The energetic son of Suta, with wrathful look, told the king of Madra, "O Shalya, Karna never takes his aim twice; with warriors like us it must always be fair play in fight.”

sa: प्रशाधि पृथिवीं राजन् यदि तेऽनुग्रहो भवेत्। प्रासादं शयनं यानं वासांस्याभरणानि च॥
en: If you wish to show your favour, rule then this Earth! They who seeks happiness but are very poor and abandoned by friends may adopt Renunciation.

sa: शलं विनिहतं संख्ये भूरिश्रवसमेव च। स्नुषाश्च विविधाः सर्वा दिष्ट्या नाद्येह पश्यसि॥
en: By good luck, you do not see to-day your son Shala killed in battle, and Bhurishravas deprived of life, and your widowed daughterin-law plunged into grief.

sa: यस्त्वया स्पर्धते नित्यं सर्वत्र पुरुषर्षभ। स एष निहतः शेते मद्रराजो महाबलः॥
en: He used everywhere, O foremost of men, to boast of his equality with you. That powerful car-warrior, viz., the king of the Madras, now lies dead.

sa: तं पश्य कदनं कृत्वा शूराणां मधुसूदन। शयानं वीरशयने रुधिरेण समुक्षितम्॥ तं
en: See, O slayer of Madhu, having made a great onslaught of enemies, that warrior is now lying on the bed of a hero, bathed in blood.

sa: किं छिद्रं को नु सङ्गो मे किं वास्त्यविनिपातितम्। कुतो मामाश्रयेद् दोष इंति नित्यं विचिन्तयेत्॥
en: The king should always think of these, viz.,-What are his shortcomings to what evil habits he is addicted, what are the sources of his weakness, and what are the sources of his follies.

sa: पुरुषो भव गान्धारे युध्यस्व सुसमाहितः। अद्य ते जीवितं नास्ति यदीन्द्रोऽपि तवाश्रयः॥
en: Be a man, O son of Gandhari and fight carefully. Today you shall have to lose your life even if Indra becomes your ally. O you

sa: तत्रोत्तरां गतिं पार्थ प्रशंसन्ति पुराविदः। संतोषो वै स्वर्गतमः संतोषः परमं सुखम्॥
en: Of these two, the northern path is spoken highly by those conversant with the Puranas. You should know that one gains heaven through contentment begets happiness.

sa: इदं तु शृणु मे पार्थ ब्रुवतः संयतेन्द्रियः। धर्ममन्ये वृत्तमन्ये धनमीहन्ति चापरे॥
en: Listen now to me with rapt attention, O son of Pritha, as I say it to you. Some seek virtue; some, good conduct, and some, wealth.

sa: सम्प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतः सर्वान् भीमसेन भयार्दितान्। दुर्योधन स्वं सूतं हा हा कृत्वेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing them thus take to their heels in fear of Bhimasena and his soldiers leave the battle field by thousands, Duryodhana, bewailing, said to his driver.

sa: यस्माङ्के क्रीडमानेन मया वै परिवर्तितम्। स मया राज्यलुब्धेन गाङ्गेयो युधि पातितः॥
en: He upon whose breast and limbs I used to play, alas, that Ganga's son has been killed by me in battle out of desire for sovereignty.

sa: एता दीर्घमिवोच्छ्वस्य विक्रुश्य च विलष्य च। विस्पन्दमाना दुःखेन वीरा जहति जीवितम्॥
en: Many of them, seeing the bodies (of their sons, husbands, or sires,) are weeping and lamcnting. Others and striking their heads with their own soft hands.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युगक्षयात् परिक्षीणे धर्मे लोके च भारत। दस्युभिः पीड्यमाने च कथं स्थेयं पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said When both virtue and men, O Bharata, suffer for the gradual lapse of a cycle and when the world is assailed by robbers, how, O Grandfather should a king then behave.

sa: प्राणस्यान्नमिदं सर्वमिति वै कवयो विदुः। स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव सर्वं प्राणस्य भोजनम्॥
en: The learned have declared that what we see is food for the strong. This mobile and immobile world is worthy of being enjoyed by the strong.

sa: कर्म चात्महितं कार्य तीक्ष्णं वा यदि वा मृदु। ग्रस्यतेऽकर्मशीलस्तु सदान\ रकिञ्चनः॥
en: Whether it is harsh or mild, a beneficial act should be done. The unfortunate man of inaction, however, is always assailed with all sorts of calamity.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पुरा वै दण्डकारण्ये राघवेण महात्मना॥ वसता राजशार्दूल राक्षसान् शमयिष्यता।
en: Vaishampayana said "Formerly, O foremost of king, the great Rama (the son of Dasharatha) lived for sometime in the forest of Dandaka, for killing the Rakshasas.

sa: मोक्षयित्वा ततो राष्ट्र प्रतिगृह्य पशून् बहून्। हृष्टात्मा नैमिषारण्यं जगाम पुनरेव सः॥
en: Having freed the kingdom from calamities and taken many kine as a gift he became pleased at heart and once more proceeded to the Naimisha forest.

sa: उत्थितानि कबन्धानि समदृश्यन्त सर्वशः॥ पपात महती चोल्का मध्येनादित्यमण्डलम्। रथैर्भग्नैर्युगाक्षैश्च निहतैश्च महारथैः॥ अश्चैनिपतितैश्चैव संछन्नाभूद् वसुन्धरा।
en: Then headless forms were seen all around. Large meteors fell down from the solar disc. The earth was covered with cars and broken on yokes and axles and slain car-warriors and lifeless horses.

sa: विप्नयातांस्तु वो भिन्नान् पाण्डवः कृतकिल्बिषान्॥ अनुसृत्य वधिष्यन्ति श्रेयान् नः समरे वधः।
en: If we however fly away disconcerted the sinsul Pandavas will pursue us and kill us all. It is better therefore that we should die in battle.

sa: संजय उवाच शल्येऽथ निहते राजन् मद्रराजपदानुगाः। रथाः सप्तशता वीरो निर्ययुर्महतो बलात्॥
en: Sanjaya said After the destruction of Shalya, O king, the followers of the Madra king, numbering seventeen hundred brave car-warriors, proceeded for battle with great force.

sa: एवं स कृत्वा ह्यात्मानं चतुर्धा भगवान् प्रभुः॥ यतो रुद्रस्ततः स्कन्दो गजामाद्भुतदर्शनः।
en: Having divided his self into four forms, he went towards the four that sat expecting him. The wonderful form called Skanda proceed where Rudra was sitting.

sa: प्रताप्य पाण्डवान् सर्वान् पञ्चालांश्चास्त्रतेजसा॥ वर्षित्य शरवर्षेण प्रताप्य रिपुवाहिनीम्। श्रीमानिव सहस्रांशुर्जगत् सर्वं प्रताप्य च॥ हतो वैकर्तनः कर्णः सपुत्रः सहवाहनः। अर्थिनां पक्षिसंघस्य कल्पवृक्षो निपातितः॥
en: Having scorched the Pandavas with the fire of his weapons, having made a down-pour of arrows and consumed the hostile armies and heated the world like the thousand rayed sun Vaikartana left the world with his sons and followers. Thus perished the hero who was an all-giving tree unto the bird-like suitors.

sa: तथेति कृत्वा राजा तौ सत्कृत्योपचचार ह॥ ततः कदाचित्तौ राजा महात्मानौ तपोधनौ।
en: After some time one day, the king, filled with joy, introduced to those illustrious ascetics his most beautiful daughter, saying,-This my daughter will serve you both.

sa: तपसा चेगित्तैश्चैव पर्वतोऽथ बुबोध तम्॥ कामार्तं नारदं क्रुद्धः शशापैनं ततो भृशम्।
en: By his ascetic power, as also by signs, Parvata understood all. Excited with rage, the latter thereupon made up his mind to curse the love-stricken Narada.

sa: एवं साध्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवः पितरस्तथा।॥ सागरा: सरितश्चैव गिरयश्च महाबलाः। ददुः सेनागणाध्यक्षान् शूलपट्टिशधारिणः॥ दिव्यप्रहरणोपेतान् नानावेपविभूषितान्।
en: Similarly the Saddhyas, the Rudra, the Vasus, the Pitris, the Seas, the Rivers and the Mountains, gave commanders of forces, armed with lances and battle axes and adorned with various kinds or ornaments.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं संसारगहनं विज्ञेयं वदतां वर एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said "O best of speakers, how may the wilderness of this world be known? I wish to hear this. Accosted by me, tell me this.”

sa: प्राणाश्च सर्वभूतानां नित्यमन्ने प्रतिष्ठिताः। तस्मात् प्रजाः प्रतिष्ठन्ते दण्डो जागर्ति तासु च॥
en: The life of all creatures depends upon food. From food creatures derive their support and growth. Punishment in the shape of king remains wakeful amongst them.

sa: तत आसीत् परामर्दस्तुमुलः शोणितोदकः। शूराणां युध्यमानानां सिंहानामिव नर्दताम्॥ तेषामासीन्महाराज व्यतिक्षेपः परस्परम्। सिंहानामामिषेप्सूनां कूजतामिव संयुगे॥
en: The encounter, between those struggling heroes marked by a great flow of blood, was highly dreadful like that which takes place between a number of roaring lions fighting for a piece of meat.

sa: विनिष्पतद्भिः शरभैः सिंहैश्च सहसा द्रुतैः। शोच्यामी दशां प्राप्तो रराजेव स पर्वतः॥
en: Sharabhas and lions suddenly run out. On account of all this, that mountain though it was reduced to a very pitiable condition still shone very beautiful.

sa: न च स्म तान्यपच्यन्त दिनं च क्षयमभ्यगात्॥ हुताशनेन दग्धश्च यस्तस्याः काष्ठसंचयः।
en: The fuel she had there was all consumed. Seeing the fire about to extinguish owing to want of fuel, she began to burn her own limbs.

sa: अहं च पूजयिष्ये त्वां समित्रगणबान्धवम्। जीवितस्य प्रदातारं कृतज्ञः को न पूजयेत्॥
en: I myself too shall adore you with all your friends and kinsmen. What grateful person is there who will not adore the giver of his life.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यदीच्छसि श्रियं तात तादृशी सा युधिष्ठिरे। विशिष्टां वा नरव्याघ्र शीलवान् भव पुत्रक॥
en: Dhritarashtra said If you wish, O sire, to acquire prosperity like that of Yudhishthira or that which is even superior to it, do you then, O son, try to be of virtuous conduct.

sa: यं पूजयेम सम्भूय यश्च नः प्रतिपालयेत्। ततो मनुं व्यादिदेश मनुर्नाभिननन्द ताः॥
en: All of us shall adore him and he shall protect us. Thus prayed for the Grandfather asked Manu. Manu, however, did not agree to the proposal.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स कृष्णेन राजा राजीवलोचनः हितार्थं सर्वलोकस्य समुत्तस्थौ महात्मनाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by Krishna, the great king (Yudhishthira) having eyes like lotus petals, rose from his seat for the well-being of the entire world.

sa: इदं हि नकुलोलूकं पापबुद्ध्याभिसंस्थितम्। न धर्षयति मार्जार तेन मे स्वस्ति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: There are the mongoose and the owl, both waiting with evil desire. O cat, so long as they do not attack me, my life is safe.

sa: मनुरुवाच बिभेमि कर्मणः पापाद् राज्यं हि भृशदुस्तरम्। विशेषतो मनुष्येषु मिथ्यावृत्तेषु नित्यदा॥
en: Manu said 'I fear all sinful deeds. To govern a kingdom is highly difficult, especially among men who are always false and deceitful in their conduct.'

sa: शकुनिरुवाच यदि मां नाभिशङ्कध्वं विभज्यात्मानमात्मना। ततोऽहं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि याथातथ्यं हितं वचः॥
en: The bird said If by acting against your better selves, you do not refuse me your faith, then I shall tell you true and beneficial words.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आरिराधयिषुः कृष्णं वाचं जिगदिधामि याम्॥ तया व्याससमासिन्या प्रीयतां पुरुषोत्तमः।
en: Bhishma said "O Krishna, O foremost of Beings, be pleased with words with I utter, in brief and in full, from desire of singing your praises.

sa: अनाद्यन्तं परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः॥ एको यं वेद भगवान् धाता नारायणो हरिः।
en: You are without beginning and without end. You are the greatest of the great and Brahma. Neither the celestials nor the Rishis know you. The divine Creator, Narayana or Hari, alone knows you.

sa: शूद्रस्यापि हि यो धर्मस्तं ते वक्ष्यामि भारत॥ प्रजापतिर्हि वर्णानां दासं शूद्रमकल्पयत्।
en: I should tell you, O Bharata, what the duties of a Shudra are. The Creator intended the Shudra as the servant of the other three castes.

sa: ततो जगति राजेन्द्र सततं शब्दितं बुधैः। देवाश्च नरदेवाश्च तुल्या इति विशाम्पते॥
en: There is no doubt in this. Since then, O king, the learned have begun to say there is no difference between a god and a king.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु धर्मेण युद्ध्यमानो न जेष्यति। अन्यायेन तु युध्यन् वै हन्यादेव सुयोधनम्॥
en: If he were to fight fairly, Bhimasena will never succeed in gaining victory. If, however, he fights unfairly, he will surely be able to kill Duryodhana.

sa: तस्य मर्मच्छिदं घोरं तीक्ष्णं चामित्रकदर्शनः। समादाय शरं श्रेष्ठं कार्मुके तु तथासृजत्॥
en: At last, taking up a very excellent arrow, sharp, terrible, and capable of cutting the very vitals, the crusher of foes, set it on his bowstring.

sa: इह द्रक्ष्यामि तं पुत्रं द्रक्ष्यामीहेति पार्थिवः। एवमाशाहतो राजा चरन् वनमिदं पुरा॥
en: I shall find my son here!-I shall find my son here!-Carried on by hope in this way, the king wandered through that forest in those days.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न ममैतत् प्रियं कृष्ण यद् राजानं वृकोदरः। पदा मूर्ध्यस्पृशत् क्रोधान्न हृष्ये कुलक्षये॥
en: Yudhishthira answered This act, O Krishna, of Vrikodara's angrily touching the head of the king with his foot, is not pleasant to me, nor am I glad at this extermination of my race!

sa: प्रसवे चैव नारीणां वृद्धानां पुत्रकारिता। तथा नरेन्द्र धनिनां साऽऽशा कृशतरी मया।॥
en: The hope that old women hold of giving birth to sons, O king, and which is cherished by rich men, is slenderer than even my body.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मित्रैः प्रहीयमाणस्य बह्वमित्रस्य का गतिः। राज्ञः संक्षीणकोशस्य बलहीनस्य भारत॥
en: Yudhishthira said How should a king behave who is shorn of friends, has many enemies, and an exhausted treasury, and is destitute of troops, O Bharata.

sa: सम्यगीहा पुनरियं यो वृद्धानुपसेवते॥ आपृच्छति च यच्छ्रेयः करोति च हितं वचः।
en: Similarly a person is crowned with success, who duly waits upon the aged, asks of them what is for his food, and obeys their good advice.

sa: शराभितापाद् व्यथितं मनो मे मधुसूदन। गात्राणि चावसीदन्ति न च बुद्धिः प्रसीदति॥
en: My mind, O destroyer of Madhu, is greatly agitated by the pain of wounds inflicted by arrows. My limbs are weak, My understanding is not clear.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हते भीष्म महेष्वासे द्रोणे कर्णे महारथे॥ कुरुष्वल्पावशिष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु च संयुगे। सुसंरब्धेषु पार्थेषु पराक्रान्तेषु संजय॥ मामकानां परेषां च किं शिष्टमभवद् बलम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said After the fall of the great bowmen Bhishma and Drona and the great car-warrior Karna and after both the Kurus and the Pandavas had been lessened in numbers and when the powerful Parthas became once more angry in battle, what, O Sanjaya, was the strength of each of the armies.

sa: दमयन्ति नलो नाम निषधेषु महीपतिः। अश्विनोः सदृशो रूपे न समास्तस्य मानुषाः॥
en: “O Damayanti, there is a prince among the Nishadhas, named Nala, who is in beauty, like the Ashvins; and he has not his equal among men.

sa: जीवतां कुरुते कार्यं पिता माता सुतास्तथा। ये चान्ये बान्धवाः केचिल्लोकेऽस्मिन् पुरुषर्षभ।॥
en: O most exalted of men, so long as a person is alive, his father, mother, son and other relations in this world are useful to him.

sa: स ते विद्यात् परं मन्त्रं प्रकृतिं चार्थधर्मयोः। विश्वासस्ते भवेत् तत्र यथा पितरि वै तथा॥
en: You may communicate to such a person your most secret counsels and the true state of never all your affairs, spiritual or temporal. You may trust him as you may your own father.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौन्तेयः सर्वान् भ्रातृनुपह्वरे। आहूष भरतश्रेष्ठ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing this, the son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) summoned all his brothers. Having summoned (them), O best of the Bharata race, he spoke these words.

sa: महत्या सेनया राजन् जग्मुर्दोणरथं प्रति। ततः सा भारतो सेना हन्यमाना किरीटिना॥
en: (Followed) by a vast army, O king, proceeded towards the car of Drona. Then that Bharata army slaughtered by Kiriti (i.e., Arjuna who wore a coronet).

sa: कर्णिका तस्य पद्मस्य मेरुर्गगनमुच्छ्रितः। तस्य मध्ये स्थितो लोकान् सृजते जगतः प्रभुः॥
en: Extending up to heaven itself, the Sumeru became the pericarp of that Lotus. Remaining within it, the powerful Lord of the Universe created all the worlds.

sa: तस्मिन् हि पुरुषव्याघ्ने कर्मभिः स्वैर्दिवं गते। भविष्यति मही पार्थ नष्टचन्द्रेव शर्वरी॥
en: After the ascension to heaven of that foremost of kings for his own achievements the Earth, O son of Pritha, will took like a moonless night.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच असुरेभ्यो भयं नास्ति युष्माकं कुत्रचित् क्वचित्। श्रूयतां यत्कृतेष्वेष संक्षोभो जायतेऽमराः॥
en: Brahma said: O immortals, there is no fear from the Asuras in any matter or in any place. Hear why all this agitation has taken place.

sa: अपतन्त रथौघाश्च तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः। तत् सैन्यं भयसंविग्नं ददाह युधि भारत॥
en: Thousands and thousands of car divisions then fell on that field; and ( Bharata, the illustrious God of fire then consumed that army of the Pandavas.

sa: अर्थाद् धर्मश्च कामश्च स्वर्गश्चैव नराधिप। प्राणयात्रापि लोकस्य विना ह्यर्थं न सिद्ध्यति॥
en: From wealth originate all religious acts, all pleasures, and heaven itself, O king, Without wealth, a man cannot find the very means of maintaining his life.

sa: परेण हि हतान् ब्रह्मन् वराहमहिषानहम्। न स्वयं हन्मि विप्रर्षे विक्रीणामि सदात्वहम्॥
en: O regenerate one, I never slay the hogs and buffaloes myself. They are slain by others. O twice-born sage, only I always sell their flesh afterwards.

sa: ततः स नरशार्दूलः प्रतिविन्ध्यं महाहवे। कुक्षिदेशेऽवधीद् राजन् स हतो न्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: Then that foremost of men, in that dreadful battle, struck Prativindhya in the abdomen at which the latter, O king, fell down lifeless on the Earth.

sa: अन्तो नास्ति पिपासायाः संतोषः परमं सुखम्। तस्मात् संतोषमेवेह परं पश्यन्ति पण्डिताः॥
en: The thirst for wealth can never be assuaged. Contentment is the highest happiness, therefore the wise men consider contentment to be the highest object to attain.

sa: एवमेते महाप्रज्ञे देवा मानुष्यमेत्य हि। ततः पुनर्गताः स्वर्गं कृते कर्मणि शोभने।॥
en: Thus, O you of great wisdom, the deities had taken birth as human beings, and after having accomplished their purposes have returned to the celestial region.

sa: न जीवितमहं सौते बहु मन्ये कथंचन। अपयातो रणाद् भीतः पृष्ठतोऽभ्याहतः शरैः॥
en: O son of Suta, having fled from the field like a coward and having been wounded at the back by arrows I consider life worth nothing?

sa: एवमुक्तश्च रुद्रेण श्वेतकिर्मनुजाधिपः॥ तथा चकार तत् सर्वं यथोक्तं शूलपाणिना। पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्षे पुनरायान्महेश्वरः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Rudra, the king Shvetaki did what he was asked to do by the wielder of Shula (Shiva). When twelve years were completed, he again came to Maheshwara (Shiva).

sa: मनुष्याणां समालम्भो न च दृष्टः कदाचन। स कथं मानुषैर्देवं यष्टुमिच्छसि शङ्करम्॥
en: The slaughter of human beings as sacrifice to the gods is never seen. Why do you then desire to sacrifice human beings to the god Sankara?

sa: तस्मिन् परिसमाप्ते तु राज्ञः सत्रे महात्मनः। दुर्वाससाभ्यनुज्ञाता विप्रतस्थुः स्म याजकः॥ ये तत्र दीक्षिताः सर्वे सदस्याश्च महौजसः। सोऽपि राजन् महाभागः स्वपुरं प्राविशत् तदा॥
en: When the sacrifice of that illustrious king came to an end, all the other priests that assisted at it went away with the permission of Durvasa. All other greatly effulgent Sadasyas also, who had been installed in that sacrifice, went away. O king, then that high-souled (royal sage) entered his own palace.

sa: कथमस्याभवद् वैरं कारणं किं च तत् प्रभो। शंस पृष्टो महाप्राज्ञ न हि तृष्यामि कथ्यति॥
en: What, O lord, was the cause of the quarrel between Vashishtha and Vishvamitra? Asked by me, O you of great wisdom, tell me all this. I am never satiated with hearing your account.”

sa: आहर्ता तस्य सत्रस्य त्वन्नान्योऽस्ति नराधिप। इति पौराणिकाः प्राहुरस्माकं चास्ति स ऋतुः॥
en: O king, you alone can accomplish it and no one else. The men, learned in the Puranas, have told us that there is such a sacrifice.

sa: दुर्बलार्थं वलं सृष्टं धात्रा मान्धातरुच्यते। अबलं तु महद्भूतं यस्मिन् सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: It is said, O Mandhatri, that the Creator created Power for for protecting Weakness. Weakness is, really, a great being, for every thing depends upon it.

sa: मा रोदीः शुभताम्राक्षि यदाह मधुसूदनः। तथा तद् भविता देवि नान्यथा वरवर्णिनी॥
en: O copper-colour-eyed lady, do not weep. What the slayer of Madhu (Krishna) has said will (surely) happen. O lady, O beautiful one, it cannot be otherwise.

sa: सोऽब्रवीत् कौरवांश्चापि पार्श्वस्थान् नृपसत्तमः॥ कदा तु तं क्रतुवरं राजसूयं महाधनम्। निहत्य पाण्डवान् सर्वानाहरिष्यामि कौरवाः॥
en: That best of kings then thus spoke to the Kurus who were near him. O Kurus, when shall I celebrate that costly and foremost of sacrifices Rajasuya after having killed all the Pandavas?

sa: ततो निशा सा व्यगमन्महात्मनां संशृण्वतां विप्रसमीरिता गिरः। ततः प्रभाते विमले द्विजर्षभा वचोऽब्रुवन् धर्मसुतं नराधिपम्॥
en: And the night wore away as they listened to the discourses of the learned Brahmanas. When the cloudless morning came, those foremost of Brahmanas addressed the royal son of Dharma, (saying as follows).

sa: मया हि दृष्टा दैतेया दानवाश्च महीपते। वर्धमाना ह्यधर्मेण क्षयं चोपगताः पुनः॥
en: O ruler of earth, I have seen many Daityas and Danavas prosper by sin, but I have also seen that destruction has again ever taken them.

sa: पितामहो नः स्थविरो मनस्वी महाप्राज्ञः सर्वधर्मोपपन्नः। स कौरव्यः कुशली तात भीष्मो यथापूर्वं वृत्तिरस्त्यस्य कच्चित्॥
en: Our grandsire is aged, wise, great in wisdom and endued with every virtue. Is this Bhishma, the son of Kunti, in health? Is he of the same habits, as in days of old?

sa: ततः पुरात् सनिष्क्रम्य रथी धन्वी शरी तली। मेघसन्धिः पदाति तं धनंजयमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Coming out of his city, Meghasandhi, mounted on his car and equipt with bow and arrows and leathern fence, rushed towards Dhananjaya who was on foot.

sa: सिंहनादरवं चक्रे बाहुशब्दं च पाण्डवः। तलशब्दं च सुमहत् कृत्वा भीमो महाबलः॥
en: Vanquishing them in battle, the highly puissant Bhimasena that son of Pandu, sent up a loud war-cry and began to strike his palms against his arms.

sa: वैकृते वासति कथं मन्यध्वं मामनागसम्। अरिं वै ब्रूत हे विप्राः सतां समय एष हि॥
en: O Brahmanas, when I have never done you any harm, why do you consider me, who am innocent, as your enemy? Tell me truly, for this is the rule followed by the honest.

sa: स्वकोष्ठस्य परीमाणं कोशस्य च महीपतिः। विज्ञाय राजा कौन्तेयो यज्ञायैव मनो दधे॥
en: Having ascertained the state of his treasury and the extent of his possessions, the son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) set his heart upon performing the (Rajasuya) sacrifice.

sa: तर्कयन्ते सुरान् हन्तुं बलदर्पसमन्विताः। देवान् न गणयन्त्येते तथा दत्तवरा हि ते॥
en: Proud of their great prowess, they are planning the destruction of the celestials, for having received the boon, they do not at all regard the celestials.

sa: लोमश उवाच तस्मै प्रादाद् वरानिन्द्र उक्तवान् यान् महातपाः। प्रतिभास्यन्ति ते वेदाः पित्रा सह यथेप्सिताः॥
en: Lomasha said : Indra granted him boons as was asked by the great ascetic. He said, "as you desire it, the Vedas will be manifest in you as well as in your father.

sa: र्यथा सुनीथस्य यथैव भानोः। तथा विनेता च गतिश्च कृष्णे तरात्मजानामपि रौक्मिणेयः॥
en: O Krishna, as the son of Rukmani (Pradyumna) is the tutor and guide to Aniruddha, Abhimanyu Sunitha and Bhanu, so he is to your sons also.

sa: यस्मादभावी भावी वा मनुष्यः सुखदुःखयोः। आगमे यदि वापाये न तत्र ग्लपयेन्मनः॥
en: Because man has sometimes the power of and sometimes becomes powerless in bringing or destroying happiness or sorrow. None should on that account, distress his mind.

sa: लोमश उवाच स तस्य ब्रह्मवध्यायाः पारं गत्वा युधिष्ठिर। अर्वावसुस्तदा सत्रमाजगाम पुनर्मुनिः॥
en: Lomasha said : ( Yudhishthira, having observed the vow prescribed in the case of killing a Brahmana, Arvavasu, the Rishi, again came back to the sacrifice.

sa: उर्वश्युवाच यथा ते चित्रसेनेन कथितं मनुजोत्तम। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा चाहमिहागता॥
en: Urvashi said: O best of men, I shall tell you all that was told to me by Chitrasena and the reason why I have come here.

sa: ततोऽष्टावक्रमातुरथान्तिके पिता नदीं समङ्गां शीघ्रमिमां विशस्व। प्रोवाच चैनं स तथा विवेश समैरङ्गैश्चापि बभूव सद्यः॥
en: Thereupon in the presence of his mother, his father said, "Speedily enter into the water of this river Samanga." Being thus told, he entered. And immediately all his (crooked) limbs were made straight.

sa: इह वत्स्यति कल्याणी सत्कृता मम वेश्मनि। इति पार्था विजानीध्वमगदं वोऽस्तु सर्वशः॥
en: The blessed lady will remain in my house (well) respected by me. O sons of Pritha, know this, and let safety by yours in every way.

sa: तत्रास्य स्वकृतं कर्म छायेवानुगतं सदा। फलत्यथ सुखा) वा दुःखार्हो वाथ जायते॥
en: In that new existence his (good and evil) acts always follow him like his shadow and the consequences thereof make his existence either pleasurable or painful.

sa: कारणं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि हेतुयोगसमासतः। सत्यमेवाभिजानीमो नानृते कुर्महे मनः। स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठामस्तस्मान्मृत्युभयं न नः॥
en: I will relate to you the reason here of briefly and argumentatively. As we strictly adhere to our own duties, we are not afraid of death.

sa: इन्द्रस्य जाम्बूनपर्वताद् वै शृणोमि घोषं तव देवि गङ्गे। गोपायैनं त्वं सुभगे गिरिभ्यः। सर्वाजमीढापचितं नरेन्द्रम्॥
en: "O Goddess Ganga, I hear your roar from this golden mountain which is sacred to Indra. (O blessed one, protect, in this mountain, this ruler of men adored of all the Ajamira race.

sa: तस्मात् तवान्तको मृत्युर्जरा वा देहनाशिनी। न त्वां विशति विप्रर्षे प्रसादात् परमेष्ठिनः॥
en: Hence through the favour of Parameshti, O Brahmana Rishi, neither death nor old age that causes the destruction of the body has any power over you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राजन् किं करवामस्ते प्रशाध्यस्मांस्त्वमीश्वरः। नित्यं हि स्थातुमिच्छामस्तव भारत शासने॥
en: Yudhisthira said O king, you are our lord. Command us what we shall do. O descendant of Bharata, we desire to remain always under your swa

sa: एकमाहुर्वैश्यवरं द्वौ तु क्षत्रस्त्रिया वरौ। त्रयस्तु राज्ञो राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणस्य शतं वराः॥
en: O king of kings, it is ordained that a Vaisya may ask one boon, a Kshatriya woman two, a Kshatriya three and a Brahmana one hundred.

sa: कथं करिष्याम्यधुना महर्षे मासश्चायं दशमो वर्तते मे। नैवास्ति ते वसु किंचित् प्रजाता येनाहमेतामापदं निस्तरेयम्॥
en: "O great king, what shall I do now, as the tenth month of my pregnancy has come! Neither you nor I possess any wealth with which we can be delivered from this distress."

sa: सम्पीड्यमाना तु तदा सुजाता सा वर्धमानेन सुतेन कुक्षौ। उवाच भर्तारमिदं रहोगता प्रसाद्य हीनं वसुनाधनार्थिनी॥
en: Having been much oppressed for the growth of the child in the womb, Sujata, who was desirous of obtaining wealth, conciliating her husband who had no wealth, spoke to him thus in private.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हतोऽसि दुर्योधन मन्दबुद्धे यस्त्वं सभायां कुरुपुङ्गवानाम्। स्त्रियं समाभाषसि दुर्विनीत विशेषतो द्रौपदी धर्मपत्नीम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O wicked minded Duryodhana, O wretch, destruction has already overtaken you when you insult in such language a wife of the Kuru chief, especially this wedded wife (of the Pandavas) Draupadi.

sa: यथागतं मार्गमवेक्षमाणः। पुनर्गिरि चैव निरीक्षमाणः। ततो महात्मा स विशुद्धबुद्धिः सम्प्रार्थयामास नगेन्द्रवर्यम्॥
en: Looked at the route which he had taken before. Then that high-souled and pure-minded being, looking at the mountain prayed to that prince of mountains, saying,

sa: ऊरू राज्ञः समासाद्य कपोतः श्येनजाद् भयात्। शरणार्थी तदा राजन् निलिल्ये भयपीडितः॥
en: O king, the pigeon from the fear of the hawk fell upon the king's thighs for protection; and it became almost dead from the great fear.

sa: यां न मृष्यन्ति वातेन स्पृश्यमानां गृहे पुरा। स्पृश्यमानां सहन्तेऽद्य पाण्डवास्तां दुरात्मना॥
en: We have never heard before that a wedded wife is brought before an assembly. That old and eternal rule is to day destroyed by the Kurus.

sa: पिबाम्यपः सदा विद्वंस्ताश्चैवं विसृजाम्यहम्। ब्रह्म वक्त्रं भुजौ क्षत्रमूरू मे संस्थिता विशः॥
en: It is I who drink up the water and create them again. From my month Brahmanas, from my arms the Kshatriyas, from my thighs the Vaishyas,

sa: न च धर्मं यथावत् त्वं वेत्सि दुर्योधनावर। यद् ब्रवीषि जितां कृष्णां न जितेति सुमन्दधीः॥
en: O younger brother of Duryodhana, you know not what really the rules of morality are. You say like a fool that this Krishna (Draupadi), who has been won, as not won (at all).

sa: उवाच वचनं चेदं प्रीयमाणः कृताञ्जलिः। सुरासुरैरसह्यं हि कर्म यत् साधितं त्वया॥
en: And with great delight, said these words with joined-hands-the feat, that you have achieved, is incapable of being borne (even) by the gods and the Asuras.

sa: मातलिरुवाच आसीदिदं पुरा पार्थ देवराजस्य नः पुरम्। ततो निवातकवचैरितः प्रच्याविताः सुराः॥
en: Matali answered O Partha, formerly it was the city of our lord of the gods. (But) afterwards the gods were expciled from here by the Nivatakavachas.

sa: यथाफलाः षण्ढतिला यथा चर्ममया मृगाः। तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे यथा काकयवा अपि॥
en: All the Pandavas are now like grains of sesame that are without kernal or toy animals incased in skins, or the grains of paddy without kernal.

sa: उक्तमात्रे त वचने तथा स मृगजीवनः। व्यसुः पपात मेदिन्यामग्निदग्ध इव दुमः॥
en: No sooner did she utter these words, than that one subsisting on chase, fell down dead on the ground, even as a tree consumed by fire.

sa: उदर्कस्तव कल्याणि कल्याणो भविता शुभे। वयं पश्याम तपसा क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि नैषधम्॥
en: "O auspicious and blessed one! you shall attain to happiness in future. We see by our power of asceticism, that ere long you shall see Naishadha.

sa: दुर्योधनो ग्लहते पाण्डवेन प्रियायसे त्वं जयतीति तच्च। अतिनर्मा जायते सम्प्रहारो यतो विनाशः समुपैति पुंसाम्॥
en: Duryodhana is gambling with the Pandava (Yudhisthira), and you are in ecstasy of joy that he is winning. It is such success that begets war which (finally) ends in the destruction of men.

sa: सुराणामसुराणां च संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। अमृतार्थं पुरा पार्थ स च दृष्टो मयानघ॥
en: "O Sinless being, in days of yore a terrible battle was fought between the gods and the demons for the sake of nectar, which I witnessed.

sa: स तेषु तीर्थेष्वभिषिक्तगात्रः कृष्णासहाय: सहितोऽनुजैश्च। सम्पूजयन् विक्रममर्जुनस्य रेमे महीपाल पतिः पृथिव्याः॥
en: O ruler of earth, that lord of earth with Krishna (Draupadi) and his younger brothers, praising the prowess of Arjuna, then lived there in great happiness.

sa: स वृत्तवांस्तेषु कृताभिषेकः सहानुजः पार्थिवपुत्रपौत्रः। समुद्रगां पुण्यतमा प्रशस्तां जगाम पारिक्षित पाण्डुपुत्रः॥
en: O son of Parikshit, bathing in them and distributing wealth, that son of Pandu with his younger brothers went to a greatly holy and broad river.

sa: भृगुरुवाच ऋतौ त्वं चैव माता च स्नाते पुंसवनाय वै। आलिङ्गेतां पृथग् वृक्षौ साश्वत्थं त्वमुदुम्बरम्॥
en: Bhrigu said : At the time of the season you and your mother after bathing at the proper time must einbrace two different trees, she as Ashvatha tree and you a fig tree.

sa: अथ वस्त्रार्धसंवीता प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम्। तां विह्वलां कृशां दीनां मुक्तकेशीममार्जिताम्॥ उन्मत्तामिव गच्छन्तीं ददृशुः पुरवासिनः। प्रविशन्तीं तु तां दृष्ट्वा चेदिराजपुरीं तदा॥ अनुजग्मुस्तत्र बाला चामिपुत्राः कुतूहलात्। सा तैः परिवृतागच्छत् समीपं राजवेश्मनः॥
en: When she entered that good city, half dressed, the citizens saw her terror-stricken, very weak and helpless, of loosened hairs, unbathed and faring even as a mad woman. Through curiosity the boys of the city pursued her, while they saw her enter into the city of the king of the Chedis. Then the damsel, thus surrounded by the boys, came to the front of the palace.

sa: नारायणेन कौरव्य तेजसाऽऽप्यायितस्तदा। स गतो नृपतिः क्षिप्रं पुत्रैस्तैः सर्वतो दिशम्॥ अर्णवं खानयामास कुवलाश्वो महीपतिः।
en: O son of the Kuru race, thereupon that ruler of men, supplied with the energy of Narayana went speedily in all directions with all of his sons. Kuvalashva, excavated that sea of sands.

sa: लोमश उवाच त्रिशतं वै सहस्राणि योजनानां युधिष्ठिर। यत्रध्वनि शृणोष्येनं तूष्णीमास्स्व विशाम्पते॥
en: Lomasha said: O Yudhishthira, O ruler of men, the place from which you hear this sound, is distant from here three hundred thousand yojanas. Keep quiet.

sa: निश्चीरां च समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति। ये त दानं प्रयच्छन्ति निश्चीरासंगमे नराः॥ ते यान्ति नरशार्दूल शक्रलोकमनामयम्। तत्राश्रमो वसिष्ठस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः॥
en: Going to Nischira which is celebrated all over the three worlds, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and goes to the region of Vishnu. The man, who gives away in charity at the confluence of Nischira. O foremost of men, goes to the blessed region of Brahma. There is the hermitage of Vasishtha, celebrated all over the world.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच विज्ञायते ते मनसोऽप्रहर्षः कच्चित् क्षत्तः कुशलेनागतोऽसि। कच्चित् पुत्राः स्थविरस्यानुलोमा वशानुगाश्चापि विशोऽथ कच्चित्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Khattwa, your mind seems to be cheerless. Do you come in peace? Are the sons (of Dhritarashtra) obedient to their old father? Are the people obedient to his (Dhritarashtra's) rule?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सर्वथा पुत्र बलिभिर्विग्रहो मे न रोचते। वैरं विकारं सृजति तद् वै शस्त्रमनायसम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O son, enmity with those that are strong is never liked by me. Enmity brings about a change of feelings, and it is itself a weapon, though not made of steel.

sa: धर्मस्य राक्षसा मूलंधर्मं ते विदुरुत्तमम्। एतत् परीक्ष्य सर्वं त्वं समीपे स्थातुमर्हसि॥
en: Rakshasas are the root of all virtues. In the beginning they knew virtue better than others. Having considered all this, you should have adhered to virtue.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा मार्कण्डेयं महाद्युतिम्। पप्रच्छ भरतश्रेष्ठ धर्मप्रश्नं सुदुर्विदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of the Bharata race, thereupon king Yudhishthira asked the most enlightened Markandeya a question that is too difficult to be understood.

sa: पोषणं तस्य राजेन्द्र चक्रे पाण्डवनन्दनः। बुबुधे न च तं पापं भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्॥
en: O king of kings, the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira) was supporting him; he could not recognise that wretch who was like the fire covered with ashes.

sa: अवाप्य सत्कारमतीव तेभ्यः प्रोवाच कस्य प्रथिताः स्थ गोपाः। ऊचुस्ततस्तेऽभ्युपगम्य सर्वे धनं तवेदं विहितं सुतस्य।॥
en: Having received very great hospitality from them, he asked them, “O cow-herds, to whom do you belong?” Thereupon they all came up to him and said, "All this wealth belongs to your son."

sa: प्रविष्टस्तत् कुलं यत्र पूर्वं चरितवांस्तु सः। देहीति याचमानोऽसौ तिष्ठेत्युक्तः स्त्रिया ततः॥
en: He, at last entered a house where he used to come before. There he asked by saying-'Give'. Thereupon he was answered by a female, saying, 'wait'.

sa: सुदेव उवाच विदर्भराजोधर्मात्मा भीमो नाम महाद्युतिः। सुतेयं तस्य कल्याणी दमयन्तीति विश्रुता॥
en: Sudeva said: There is a virtuous and illustrious king of the Vidharbhas, named Bhima, whose daughter is this blessed lady, known by the name of Damayanti.

sa: यद् ब्राह्मणानां कुशलं तदेषां परिकीर्तयेत्॥ सत्यं तथा व्याहरतां नानृते रमते मनः।
en: What is agreeable to the Brahmanas repeats before them. The mind of those, who always walk in the path of truth, never takes pleasure in untruth.

sa: यद्यागमैर्न विद्यां च तमहं भूतभावनम्। क्रमेयं त्वां गिरि चैव हनूमानिव सागरम्॥
en: Had I not known him from whom all creatures have become manifest, I would have overleaped you, also this mountain, even as Hanuman did the ocean.

sa: ततः सा न चिरादेव विदर्भानगमत् पुनः। तु बन्धुजनः सर्वः प्रहृष्टः समपूजयत्॥
en: Then the lady immediately went away to the country of the Vidharbhas, where all her friends and relatives, satisfied with her arrival, offered praises to her.

sa: तदवस्थां तु तां दृष्ट्वा सर्वमन्तःपुरं तदा। हाहाभूतमतीवासीद् भृशं च प्ररुरोद ह॥
en: Thereupon all the inmates of the king's harem uttered the exclamations of 'Oh'! and 'Alas'! at this dangerous situation of Damayanti and also wept most bitterly.

sa: एतच्छु त्वा वचो राजन् कृत्वा निष्कृतिमात्मनः। स गत्वा पुनरागच्छत् प्रसन्नेषु द्विजातिषु॥
en: O king, having heard these words and resolving to make atonement (for his past misdeeds) he went and came back when the Brahmanas had become appeased.

sa: प्राज्ञो धर्मेण रमते धर्मं चैवोपजीवति। तस्माद् धर्मादवाप्तेन घनेन द्विजसत्तम॥ तस्यैव सिञ्चते मूलं गुणान् पश्यति तत्र वै। धर्मात्मा भवति ह्येवं चित्तं चास्य प्रसीदति॥
en: The wise man delights in virtue and he lives by virtue. O foremost of Brahmanas, such a man with the wealth of virtue which he thus acquires waters the root of the plant (particular righteousness) in which he finds most virtue. The virtuous man thus acts and his mind becomes thus calin.

sa: पूर्णे पूर्णे त्रिरात्रे तु मासमेकं फलाशनः। द्विगुणेन हि कालेन द्वितीयं मासमत्ययात्॥
en: He ate fruits in the first month (of his asceticism) at the interval of three nights, in the second (month) at the interval of six nights.

sa: ततो लोभाभिभूतस्य रागद्वेषहतस्य च। न धर्मे जायते बुद्धिर्व्याजाद् धर्मं करोति च॥
en: When men are thus influenced by avarice, envy and attachment, their understanding does not lean towards virtue; and they then practise the very mockery of virtue.

sa: अगृहणाच्च वरं तस्माद् गङ्गायाधारणे नृप। स्वर्गे वासं समुद्दिश्य पितॄणां स नरोत्तमः॥
en: With the intention of making his ancestors go to heaven, O king, he obtained from him the boon that he would sustain Ganga (on his head).

sa: ततो वृष्णिप्रवीरा ये ममासन् सैनिकास्तदा। ते भयार्ता दिशः सर्वे सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Thereupon the foremost heroes of the Vrishni race who were in my army were seized with panic and they suddenly began to fly in all directions.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अश्नाम्याच्छादये चाहं यथा कुपुरुषस्तथा। अमर्षं धारये चोग्रं निनिषुः कालपर्ययम्॥
en: Duryodhana said I, no doubt, eat and dress but I pass my time all the while like a wretch, for I am a prey to jealousy.

sa: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भा निराशीर्बन्धनाः सदा। त्यागे यस्य हुतं सर्वं स त्यागी स च बुद्धिमान्॥
en: He whose actions are performed not with the object of securing any reward or blessing, who has sacrificed all to the requirements of his renunciation is a real Sanyasi and is really wise.

sa: कृतो यत्नो मया पूर्वं विनाशे तस्य सौबल। तच्च सर्वमतिक्रम्य संवृद्धोऽप्स्विव पङ्कजम्॥
en: O son of Subala, I forinerly tried to destroy hiin, but baffling all my efforts, he has grown in prosperity like the lotus (in the tank).

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच बाढमित्येव तौ विप्रः प्रत्युवाच मुदान्वितः। धर्मव्याधो निरीक्ष्याथ ततस्तं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Markandeya said : The Brahmana replied in gladness by saying, “Yes, I am not face any difficulty". Then the virtuous Fowler thus spoke to the Brahmana.

sa: एतावेवाग्नयो मह्यं यान् वदन्ति मनीषिणः। यज्ञा वेदाच चत्वारः सर्वमेतौ मम द्विज॥
en: To me they are like the three sacred fires mentioned by the learned. O Brahmana, they are to me as the sacrifices in the four Vedas.

sa: एकैकशस्ततः कृत्वा बीजं बीजं नराधिपः। घृतपूर्णेषु कुम्भेषु तान् भागान् विदधे ततः॥
en: That ruler of men took out separately each one of the seeds and he then kept these divisions (of the gourd) in vessels filled with Ghee.

sa: स तत्र कुण्डिने रम्ये वसमानो महीपतिः। न च किंचित् तदापश्यत् प्रेक्षमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः। स तु राज्ञा समागम्य विदर्भपतिना तदा॥ अकस्मात् सहसा प्राप्तं स्त्रीमन्त्रं न स्म विन्दति। किं कार्यं स्वागतं तेऽस्तु राजा पृष्टः स भारत॥
en: While residing in that beautiful city of Kundina, that ruler of the earth saw nothing (no signs of the Svayamvara) there, although he looked about all again and again. Then, at last, the lord of the Vidharbhas presented himself before that monarch and welcomed him. O descendant of the Bharata race, Bhima asked him on what business he was pleased to come there; for, in the absence of a proper occasion, an illustrious personage can not be had.

sa: न शोचामि च वै विद्वन् कालाकाक्षी स्थितो ह्यहम् एतैर्निदर्शनैर्ब्रह्मन् नावसीदामि सत्तम॥
en: O excellent man, O learned one, I too do not grieve. I wait abiding my time. For this reason I am not confined (in any way).

sa: तेन वाक्ये कृते सम्यक् प्रतिवाक्ये तथाऽऽहते। उपायोऽयं मया दृष्टो नैषधानयने तव॥
en: It was after hearing his words and your proper answer thereto, that I devised this project in order to receive the king of the Nishadhas back.

sa: अनभ्रे प्रववर्ष द्यौः पपात ज्वलिताशनिः। कृष्णेन निहते चैद्ये चचाल च वसुंधरा॥
en: When the Chedi king was killed by Krishna, the cloudless sky poured showers of rain, blasting thunders were hurled and the earth itself began to tremble.

sa: तेन वीरेण तं हत्वा सगणं राक्षसाधमम्। आनीता स्वपुरं सीता कीर्तिश्चाख्यापिता नृषु॥
en: By killing that lord of the Rakashasas together with his followers and bringing back Sita to his own city, that hero established his fame among men.

sa: मत्पूर्वां रुक्मिणी कृष्ण संसत्सु परिकीर्तयन्। विशेषतः पार्थिवेषु व्रीडां न कुरुषे कथम्॥
en: Shishupala said O Krishna, are you not ashamed to talk in this assembly, specially before all these kings, of Rukinani who had been intended for me.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवो राजंस्तव्यमानं महावने। अन्वशोचत कौन्तेयः प्रियं वै भ्रातरं जयम्॥
en: O king, having heard that his beloved brother, the son of Kunti, Yaja (Arjuna) was thus undergoing asceticism in the great forest Yudhishthira began to grieve.

sa: या जनित्री त्वप्सरसां गर्भमास्ते प्रगृह्य सा॥ उपनष्टं ततो गर्भ कथयन्ति मनीषिणः।
en: She who is the mother of the Apsaras removes the fetus from the womb. And then the learned men say that the conception has become stationary.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु शक्रेण त्रिदिवं कृत्तिका गताः। नक्षत्रं सप्तशीर्षाभं भाति तद् वह्निदैवतम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed (by Indra), Skanda sent Kritika. She was placed in heavens. That star, presided over by Agni, shone as if with seven heads.

sa: इमामवस्थां च गते सहास्माभिररिंदम। हन्त नष्टाः स्म सर्वे वै भवतोपद्रवे सति॥
en: O chastiser of foes, you have fallen into this state along with me. Alas! we too are lost with you on account of your this calamity.

sa: पादपानां च या माता करञ्जनिलया हि सा। वरदा सा हि सौम्या च नित्यं भूतानुकम्पिनी॥
en: She, who is the mother of all trees, dwells in a Karanja tree. She is a giver of boons, she has a placid countenance and she is always favourably disposed towards all creatures.

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच वित्तकामानिह प्राप्तान् विद्धि नः पृथिवीपते। यथाशक्त्यविहिंस्यान्यान् संविभागं प्रयच्छ नः॥
en: Agastya said: O ruler of earth, know, that I have come to you for wealth. Give me a portion of your wealth according to your ability.

sa: मिञ्जिकामिञ्जिकं चैव मिथुनं रुद्रसम्भवम्। नमस्कार्यं सदैवेह बालानां हितमिच्छता॥ स्त्रियो मानुषमांसादा वृद्धिका नाम नामतः। वृक्षेषु जातास्ता देव्यो नमस्कार्याः प्रजार्थिभिः॥ एवमेते पिशाचानामसंख्येय गणाः स्मृताः। घण्टायाः सपताकायाः शृणु मे सम्भवं नृप॥
en: Minjika and Minjika, begotten by Rudra should always be worshipped by those who desire the good of their children. Those who desire to have children born to them should always worship those female spirits that live on human flesh and that are produced in trees. Thus all Pishachas are divided into innumerable classes. O king, hear now the origin of the bells and standards of Skanda.

sa: गतो भद्रवट रुद्रो निवृत्ताश्च दिवौकसः। उक्ताश्च देवा रुद्रेण स्कन्दं पश्यत मामिव॥
en: Rudra returned to Bhadravata and the celestials returned to their respective abodes. The celestials were thus addressed by Rudra, “Look at Skanda as you do me.

sa: यस्य चानेन धर्मज्ञ भुक्तमन्नं बलीयसः। स चानेन हतः कंस इत्येतन्न महाद्भुतम्॥
en: O (Bhishma) learned in the precepts of religion, what could be more wonderful than this one's killing Kansa, by whose food he became fattened and strong.

sa: नावि नौरिव सम्बद्धा यथान्धो वान्धमन्वियात्। तथाभूता हि कौरव्या येषां भीष्म त्वमग्रणीः॥
en: O Bhishma, when you are their leader the Purus are like a boat tied to a boat, or like a blind man following a blind man.

sa: स्थित: सेनापतिर्योऽहं मन्यध्वं किं तु साम्प्रतम्। युधि तिष्ठाम संना समेतान् वृष्णिपाण्डवान्॥
en: “When I am here to be the generalissimo, what are you thinking now? In battle array let us stand against the assembled Vrishnis and the Pandavas".

sa: जन्मप्रभृति यत् पापं स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेण वा॥ पुष्करे स्नातमात्रस्य सर्वमेव प्रणश्यति।
en: Whatever sins a man or a woman commits from his and her birth, are all destroyed at the very moment he or she bathes in Pushkara.

sa: तत्रोष्य रजनी: पञ्च पूतात्मा जायते नरः। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति सिद्धिं प्राप्नोति चोत्तमाम्॥
en: He who lives there for five nights has his soul cleansed of all sins. He does not meet with any distress; he obtains the highest success.

sa: अवश्यं च त्वया भूमिरियं निहतकण्टका। भर्तृभिः सह भोक्तव्या निर्द्वन्द्वेति श्रुतं मया।॥
en: It has been heard by me that you will with your husbands enjoy without any doubt this earth in peace and free from all thorns. never

sa: स चाह्वयति यं वाचा गतं वैवस्वतक्षयम्। स पुनर्देहमास्थाय जीवन् स्म प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: For he, whom he (Ilvala) summoned with his voice, would at once come back to him if he had gone even to the abode of Yama.

sa: राक्षसा ऊचुः आक्रीडोऽयं कुबेरस्य दयितः पुरुषर्षभ। नेह शक्यं मनुष्येण विहर्तुं मर्त्यधर्मणा॥
en: The Rakshasas said : O foremost of men, this place is the favourite play-ground of Kubera. Men subject to the laws of earth cannot sport here.

sa: यदि न स्युर्मानुषेषु क्षमिणः पृथिवीसमाः। न स्यात् संधिर्मनुष्याणां क्रोधमूलो हि विग्रहः॥
en: If there were not persons amongst mankind equal to the earth in forgiveness there would be no peace amongst them but perpetual dissension's engendered by anger.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र देव्याः स्थानं सुदुर्लभम्। शाकम्भरीति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent celestials region which is known all over the three worlds by the name of Shakambhari.

sa: यथा तीर्थानि गच्छेत गाश्च दद्यात् स पार्थिवः। तथा सर्वात्मना कार्यमिति मामर्जुनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Do that with all your heart by which that king Yudhishthira may visit all the Tirthas and give away (in charity). Arjuna said this to ine.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे वागुवाचाशरीरिणी। न शक्यो दुर्गमो गन्तुमितो वैश्रवणाश्रमात्॥
en: When that king of kings had said this, an invisible voice spoke thus, “You will not be able to go to the inaccessible abode of Vaisravana.

sa: त्वां च व्यसनमभ्यागादिदं भारत दुःसहम्। यत् त्वं नार्हसि नापीमे भ्रातरस्ते महौजसः॥
en: Or else, O descendant of Bharata, this unbearable misfortune would not have befallen you, who are so unworthy of it and your brothers of great energy.

sa: उक्तश्च त्रिपुरघ्नेन परितुष्टेन भारत। अपि च त्वं प्रियतरो लोके कृष्ण भविष्यसि॥ त्वन्मुखं च जगत् सर्वं भविष्यति न संशयः। तत्राभिगम्य राजेन्द्र पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गाणपत्यं च विन्दति। धूमावतीं ततो गच्छेत् त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ मनसा प्रार्थितान् कामाँल्लभते नात्र संशयः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, having been thus gratified, the destroyer of Tripura said, “O Krishna, you shall certainly be very beloved on earth. There is no doubt you will be the foremost being in the universe." O king of kings, going there and worshipping Vrishadhvaja (Shiva). One obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and acquires the state of Ganapatya. Then one should go to Dhumavati and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains without doubt all the desires that he entertains in his mind.

sa: ईप्सितं तु करिष्यामि मनसस्तव पाण्डव॥ तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा प्राञ्जलिः शिरसा नतः।
en: So long as there will be a scion in the King Nila's dynasty. O son of Pandu, I shall, however, accomplish the desire of your heart.”

sa: दृश्यन्ते शैलशृङ्गेषु पार्थ किम्पुरुषैः सह। गीतानां समतालानां तथा साम्नां च निःस्वनः॥
en: And accompanied by the Kimpurushas, O Partha, are seen on the summits of the mountain. Songs exactly keeping time and also the chanting of the Samaveda,

sa: अपश्यंस्ते नरव्याघ्रा गन्धमादनसानुषु। तथैव पद्मपण्डैश्च मण्डितांश्च समन्ततः॥ शिखण्डिनीभिः सहिताँल्लतामण्डलकेषु च। मेघतूर्यरवोद्दाममदनाकुलितान् भृशम्॥ कृत्वैव केकामधुरं संगीतं मधुरस्वरम्। चित्रान् कलापान् विस्तीर्य सविलासान् मदालसान्।। मयूरान् ददृशुर्हष्टान् नृत्यतो वनलालसान्। कांश्चित् प्रियाभिः सहितान् रममाणान् कलापिनः॥६२। वल्लीलतासंकटेषु कुटजेषु स्थितांस्तथा। कांश्चिच्च कुटजानां तु विटपेषूत्कटानिव्र॥ कलापरुचिराटोपनिचितान् मुकुटानिव। विवरेषु तरूणां च रुचिरान् ददृशुश्च ते॥
en: And in the groves of creepers they beheld those joyful-wood-loving peacocks with their mates, maddened with an excess of animal propensity caused by the sound of the clouds resembling the trumpet-notes, sportive and drowsy with lust, dancing with their gorgeous tails out spread and warbling forth sweet and melodious notes. Some of the peacocks, seated on the Kutaja trees densely carpeted with creepers, were sporting with their sweet hearts; some, seated on the boughs of the Kutaja trees and proud of their splendid tails spread out looked like so many crowns worn by the trees; and some seated in the holes of trees looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: किमाहृत्य विदित्वा वा प्रीतिस्ते स्याद् भुजङ्गम्। किमाहारं प्रयच्छामि कथं मुञ्चेद् भवानिमम्॥
en: O snake, by obtaining or knowing what will you be satisfied? What food shall I provide for you? Under what conditions will you let him off?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वानुजग्मुस्ते पाण्डवांस्तान् समेत्य च। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे कौन्तेयान् माद्रिनन्दनान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, they all went together after the Pandavas. With joined hands, they thus spoke to the sons of Kunti and Madri.

sa: एवमेतन्मतं सर्प ताभ्यां हीनं न विद्यते। यथा शीतोष्णयोर्मध्ये भवेन्नोष्णं न शीतता॥
en: It seems (at indeed first sight) that existence is impossible without these (feelings). But as cold is characterised by an absence of heat and heat cold,

sa: न तत् कुलं न चाचारो न धर्मोऽर्थः कुतः सुखम्। यत्र पापसहायोऽयं पापो राज्यं चिकीर्षति॥
en: When this sinful man with the help of other sinful men aspires to the kingdom, our families, usages, virtue and prosperity are all doomed. How can there be happiness (where these are destroyed)?

sa: यतो यतः सा सुदती मामुपाधावदन्तिके। ततस्ततो मुखं चारु मम देवि विनिर्गतम्॥
en: In whatever direction that lady of beautiful teeth turned, a new face to mine instantly appeared. All these faces of mine became handsome to look at.

sa: कीट उवाच सुखात् सुखतरं प्राप्तो भगवंस्त्वत्कृते ह्यहम्॥ धर्ममूलां श्रियं प्राप्य पाप्मा नष्ट इहाद्य मे।
en: The Worm said Through your favour, O Holy one, I have attained from happy to happier positions! Having obtained such prosperity as is established in virtue, I think my demerits have been lost.

sa: ततः प्रचोदिता राज्ञा वनं गत्वास्य मन्त्रिणः। प्रचीयोदुम्बराणि स्म दातुं तेषां प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: After this, urged by their master, the ministers of the king, entered those woods and plucking certain figs tried to give them away to those Rishis.

sa: लोकेऽस्मिन् यानि सत्त्वानि सानि स्थावराणि च। तान्येवाग्रे प्रलीयन्ते पश्चाद् भूतकृता गुणाः।
en: Whatever exist in this world, mobile and immobile, are the very first to be dissolved away. After this (are dissolved) those qualities which compose all entities.

sa: अत्र त्वा मन्यतां भ्राता पिता माता सखेति च। मन्त्रयस्वैनमुन्नीय परवन्तं विशेषतः॥
en: Let the brother, father, mother, and friend give you their approval in this. Taking him (to them) do you consult them. This goat is cspccially dependent.

sa: प्राणा अप्यस्य छागस्य प्रापितास्ते स्वयोनिपु। शरीरं केवल शिष्टं निश्चेष्टमिति मे मतिः॥
en: The vital airs of this goat have been made to return to their respective sources. Only the inanimate body remains behind. This is what I think.

sa: न्यासापहर्ता तु नरो यमस्य विषयं गतः। संसाराणां शतं गत्वा कृमियोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: That man who misappropriates what is deposited with him in trust, has to undergo a hundred births. He at last takes birth as a vile worm.

sa: वरं ददामि ते हन्त वृणीष्व त्वं यदिच्छसि। यच्चाप्यवाप्यं हृदि ते सर्वं तद् ब्रूहि माचिरम्॥
en: I shall give you boons. Do you name the boons. Do not delay, but tell me what is in your mind. Even if it be unattainable, I Shall yet bestow it on you.

sa: स तेन वारणो राजन् मर्मस्वभिहतो भृशम्। पपात सहसा भूमौ वज्ररुग्ण इवाचलः॥
en: Cut to the quick, O king, by the son of Pandu, the beast suddenly dropped down on the Earth like a mountain-summit loosened by a thunder-bolt.

sa: ब्राह्मणे कीदृशो धर्मः क्षत्रिये कीदृशोऽभवत्। वैश्ये किंलक्षणो धर्मः शूद्रे किंलक्षणो भवेत्॥
en: What are the duties of the Brahmana? What of the Kshatriya? What are the duties of the Vaishya? And what are the duties of the Shudra.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यद् वरं सर्वतीर्थानां तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह। यत्र चैव परं शौचं तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, o grandfather of that which is considered as the foremost of all Tirthas. Indeed, you should expound to me what that Tirtha is which conduces to the greatest purity.

sa: परं हि ब्रह्म कथितं योगयुक्तेन तन्मया। इतिहासं तु वक्ष्यामि तस्मिन्नर्थे पुरातनम्॥
en: I described to you, O Supreme Brahina having concentrated myself in Yoga. I shall now, however, recite to you an old history upon the same subject.

sa: अजानन्त्या नियुक्तः स भगवन् ब्राह्मणो मया। भवत्प्रसादान्न भयं किंचित् तस्य भविष्यति॥
en: Ahalya said Without knowing this, O holy one I have engaged Utanka in this task. He shall not, however, come by any danger through your grace.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयमश्वो यथा ब्रह्मन्नुस्तृष्टः पृथिवीमिमाम्। चरिष्यति यथाकामं तत्र वै संविधीयताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Let arrangements be made by you, O twiceborn one, about loosening this horse for enabling it to wander over the Earth at its will.

sa: सर्वं कृतं विनाशान्तं जातस्य मरणं ध्रुवम्। अशाश्वतं हि लोकेऽस्मिन् सदा स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: All action ends in destruction, and all that is born is certain to meet with death. Every mobile and immobile thing in this world is fickle.

sa: तया चाप्यभवन्मिश्रो गर्भे चास्यादधे तदा। ववृधे स तदा गर्भः कक्षे कृष्णगतिर्यथा।॥
en: He knew her and caused her to conceive. Indeed, in the womb of Ganga the seed of Agni began to grow even as Agni himself grows.

sa: स पीड्यमानो बहुभिः क्षीणकोशाश्ववाहनः। आर्तिमाळुत् परां राजा सह भृत्यैः पुरेण च॥
en: Being thus oppressed by many enemies while his treasury, horses and vehicles were impoverished, the king suffered great tribulation along with his retainers and the citizens.

sa: यो हि खादति मांसानि प्राणिनां जीवितैषिणाम्। हतानां वा मृतानां वा यथा हन्ता तथैव सः॥
en: He who eats the flesh of animals are who desirous of living but who have been slain by either himself or others, commits the sin of slaughter for his this act of cruelty.

sa: यथा द्रव्यं च कर्ता च संयोगोऽप्यनयोस्तथा। यथा प्रदीपमादाय कश्चित् तमसि गच्छति।
en: Forsooth, Purusha is unattached like the unsteady drop of water on the lotus leaf. This is the certain conclusion that Nature is the property of Purusha.

sa: न तेषां विद्यते दुःख गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम्। ये शृण्वन्ति महद् ब्रह्म सावित्रीगुणकीर्तनम्॥ गवां मध्ये तु पठतो गावोऽस्य बहुवत्सलाः। प्रस्थाने वा प्रवासे वा सर्वावस्थां गतः पठेत्॥
en: Whether when starting on a journcy, or entering a house on returning, one should recite these Mantras on every occasion. These Mantras forin a great mystery of the Rishis and are the very highest of those which they silently recite. Such are these Mantras to them who practice the duty of recitation and pour libations on the sacrificial fire.

sa: देवकन्यानिवासे च तस्मिन् वसति मानवः। जाह्नवीवालुकाकीर्णं पूर्णे संवत्सरं नरः॥ यस्तु पक्षे गते भुङ्क्ते एकभक्तं जितेन्द्रियः। सदा द्वादशमासान् जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्॥ राजसूयसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्। यानमारोहते दिव्यं हंसबहिणसेवितम्॥
en: That man who, keeping his senses under restraint, fasts for a fortnight and takes only one meal on the sixteenth day, and acts thus for a whole year, pouring libations every day on his sacred fire, acquires the great merits of a thousand Rajasuya sacrifices. The car he rides, is highly beautiful and is drawn by swans and peacocks.

sa: स्थितस्य वृक्षमूलेषु तस्य चिन्ता बभूव ह। उत्सृज्य सुमहत्कर्म सूक्ष्म प्रति महामते॥४॥
en: While sitting at the root of a tree, his thoughts, O you of great intelligence, abandoning all those great deeds, turned towards that which is subtle!

sa: तच्चाचष्ट तदा व्यासो मरुत्तस्य धनं नृपाः। यद्येतद् वो बहुमतं मन्यध्वं वा क्षमं यदि॥ तथा यथाऽऽह धर्मेण कथं वा भीम मन्यसे। इत्युक्तवाक्ये नृपतौ तदा कुरुकुलोद्वह॥ भीमसेनो नृपश्रेष्ठं प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। रोचते मे महाबाहो यदिदं भाषितं त्वया॥ व्यासाख्यातस्य वित्तस्य समुपानयनं प्रति। यदि तत् प्राप्नुयामेह धनमाविक्षितं प्रभो॥ कृतमेव महाराज भवेदिति मतिर्मम। ते वयं प्रणिपातेन गिरीशस्य महात्मनः॥ तदानयाम भद्रं ते समभ्यर्च्य कपर्दिनम्। तद् वित्तं देवदेवेशं तस्यैवानुचरांश्च तान्॥ प्रसाद्यार्थमवाप्स्यामो
en: You kings, Vyasa, therefore, informed us of the wealth of Marutta. If you think that wealth abundant or sufficient, how shall we bring it? What, O Bhima, do you think about this? us When the king, O perpetuator of Kuru's race, said these words, Bhimasena, joining his hands, said these words in reply, The words you have said, O you of mighty arms, on the subject of bringing the riches indicated by Vyasa, are approved by me? If, O powerful one, we succeed in getting the riches kept there by the son of Avikshita, then this sacrifice, o king, purposed by will be easily accomplished! This is what I think. We shall, therefore, bowing our heads to the great Girisha, and off-ring duc adoration to that deity, bring that wealth. Blessed be you. Pleasing that god of gods as companions and followers,

sa: यदि चेत् खादको न स्यान्न तदा घातको भवेत्। घातकः खादकार्थाय तद् घातयति वै नरः॥
en: If there were nobody who ate flesh there would then be nobody to slay living creatures. The man who slays living creatures kills them for the sake of the person who eats flesh.

sa: निवृत्तिलक्षणस्त्वन्यो धर्मो मोक्षाय तिष्ठति। तस्य वृत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु मे देवि तत्त्वतः॥
en: The Religion of Renunciation is different. It exists for liberation. I shall tell you the conduct that constitutes it. Listen to me in full, O goddess.

sa: गन्धर्वा गीतकुशला नृत्येषु च विशारदाः। रमयन्ति स्म तान् विप्रान् यज्ञकर्मान्तरेषु वै॥
en: At intervals of the sacrificial rites, those Gandharvas skilled in music and well-versed in dancing, used to please the Brahmanas who were engaged in the sacrifice.

sa: आदत्ते रश्मिभिः सूर्यो दिवि तिष्ठंस्ततस्ततः। रसं हृतं वै वर्षासु प्रवर्षति दिवाकरः॥
en: Passing through the sky, he draws up the moisture from the Earth and in the form of rains he pours it down once more on her.

sa: अन्तर्वेद्यां च यद् दत्तं श्रद्धया चानृशंस्यतः। किंस्विन्नैःश्रेयसं तात तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Do you tell me, O grandfather, what brings on the highest reward, viz., gifts made from the sacrificial platform or those made out of that place?

sa: स वै मनुष्यतां गच्छेद् यदि कालस्य पर्ययात्। बह्वाबाधपरिक्लिष्टे जायते सोऽधमे कुले॥
en: If in course of time he is born as man in a low and wretched family which meets with obstacles of every kind on every side.

sa: कथं शुभाशुभे चायं कर्मणी स्वकृते नरः। उपभुङ्क्ते क्व वा कर्म विदेहस्यावतिष्ठते॥
en: How does a human being enjoy the good and bad deeds done by him? Where do the acts exist of one that is devoid of body?

sa: अकरोत् स ततः कालं शरतल्पगतो मुनिः। अयनं दक्षिणं हित्वा सम्प्राप्ते चोत्तरायणे॥
en: Lying on abcd of arrows, Bhishma waited like an ascetic till the sun leaving his southwards path entered on his northerly course when that hero died.

sa: ननु त्वया नाम विभो धर्मराजस्य यज्ञियः। अयमश्वोऽनुसर्तव्यः स शेष किं महीतले॥
en: Indeed, O powerful one, this sacrificial horse of king Yudhishthira the just, should be followed by you. Why then do you lie still on the Earth.

sa: एषा सुवर्णस्योत्पत्तिः कथिता ते मयानघ। कार्तिकेयस्य च विभो तद् विद्धि भृगुनन्दन॥
en: I have thus told you, O sinless one, the origin of gold. O you of power, know how Kartikeya grew up, O delighter of Bhrigu's race.

sa: ततः प्रविश्य नगरं कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकी: क्रियाः। भुक्त्वा सभार्यो रजनीमुवास स महाद्युतिः॥
en: Having entered his city and performed all his morning rites, he ate with his wife. Gifted with great splendour, the king then passed the night happy.

sa: संवत्सरमिहैकं तु मासि मासि पिबेदपः। फलं विश्वजितस्तात प्राप्नोति स नरो नृप॥
en: He who passes a whole year, drinking only a little water at the termination of every month, acquires, O king, the merit of the Vishvajit sacrifice.

sa: जनक उवाच पितृपैतामहे राज्ये वश्य जनपदे सति। विषयं नाधिगच्छामि विचिन्वन् पृथिवीमहम्॥
en: Although a (large) inhabited dominion is subject 10 me within this ancestral kingdom of mine, yield fail to find my dominion, searching through the whole Earth.

sa: नाध्यगच्छं तदा तस्यां तदा मे कश्मलोऽभवत्। ततो मे कश्मलस्यान्ते मतिः पुनरुपस्थिता॥
en: When I could not find it even there, a cloudedness of understanding came over me. After that cloudedness of understanding departed, intelligence came back to me.

sa: इष्टभार्यस्य ते नूनं प्रातिवेश्यो महाधनः। युवा सुललित: कामी तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Some rich neighbour of yours, endued with youth and handsome features, covets your dear wife. It is for this that you aic so pale and lean.

sa: वाङ्मनःकर्मजैर्ग्रस्तः पापैरपि पुमानिह। वीक्ष्य गङ्गां भवेत् पूतो अत्र मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: I have no doubt in this that the person who is afflicted with sins perpetrated in words and thought and act, becomes cleansed on seeing Ganga.

sa: महर्षे विदितं भूयः सर्वमेतत् तवानघ। तेऽत्यक्रामन् मतिं मह्यं भीष्मस्य विदुरस्य च॥
en: O great Rishi, O sinless one, this also cannot he unknown to you. They (the Kauravas) disregarded which Bhishma and Vidura gave them referring to me.

sa: हेमन्तकाले सलिलं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति। स वै बहुसुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलम्॥
en: That person in whose tank water lics in the cold season acquires the merit of the wight who performs a sacrifice with profuse gifts of gold.

sa: असद् वा हसितं किंचिदहितं वापि कर्मणा। रहस्यमरहस्यं वा न प्रवामि सर्वथा।॥
en: I never did any evil deed. I never laughed aloud; I never did any injury; I never gave out any secret. Thus did I myself act.

sa: एषा माता पिता चैव जगतः पृथिवीयते। नानया सदृशं भूतं किंचिदस्ति जनाधिप।॥
en: The Earth is both the mother and father of the universe of creatures, O king. There is no element, O king, that can compare with Earth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तथा निमौ प्रवृत्ते तु सर्व पितृयज्ञं तु कुर्वन्ति विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥ एव महर्षयः।
en: Bhishma said After Nini had acted thus, all the great Rishis began to celebrate the sacrifice in honour of the departed Manes (called the Shraddha) according to rites laid down in the ordinance.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मागधेनार्चितो राजन पाण्डवः श्वेतवाहनः। दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय चारयामास तं हयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : Adored by the king of Magadha, Pandu's son having white horses yoked to his car, proceeded along the south, following the (sacrificial) horse.

sa: इमं च ब्रह्मलोकं च लोकं च बलवत्तरम्। अन्नदानैः सुकृतिनः प्रतिपद्यन्ति लौकिकाः॥
en: By making gifts of food righteous men of this world obtain both this world and that of Brahiman himself with many other regions of superior happiness.

sa: प्रभासं मानसं तीर्थे पुष्कराणि मह्वत्सरः। पुण्यं च नैमिषं तीर्थे बाहुदां करतोयिनीम्॥ गयां गयशिरश्चैव विपाशां स्थूलवालुकाम्। कृष्णां गङ्गां पञ्चनदं महाह्रदमथापि च॥ गोमती कौशिकी पम्पां महात्मानो धृतव्रताः। सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्यौ यमुनां ये तु यान्ति च॥ तत्र ते दिव्यसंस्थाना दिव्यमाल्यधराः शिवाः। प्रयान्ति पुण्यगन्धाढ्या धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र वै॥
en: They who go to Prabhasa and Manasa, the lakes of Pushkara, the large lake called Mahatsara the sacred forest of Naimisha, Vahuda, Karatoya, Ganga, Gayashiras, Vipasha, Sthulavaluka, Krishna, the five rivers (of the Punjab), the extensive lake called Mahahrada, Gomati, Kaushiki, Champa, Sarasvati, Drishadvati, and Yamuna, indeed those illustrious Brahmanas, firm in the observance of vows, who go to these sacred waters, go to the regions of which you speak. Gifted with celestial bodies and adorned with celestial garlands, those blessed individuals, always emitting the sweetest perfumes, go to the regions of joy. Indeed, Dhritarashtra shall not go there.

sa: कां वा ब्राह्मणपूजायां व्युष्टिं दृष्ट्वा महाव्रत। तानसि महाबाहो सर्वमेतद् वदस्व मे॥
en: O you of high vows, secing what prosperity of the worship of the Brahmanas, do you worship them? Tell me all this, you of mighty arms.

sa: ततो देवगिरौ तस्मिन् रम्ये पुण्ये सनातने। न शर्वं भूतसंधं वा ददृशुर्मुनयस्तदा॥
en: Then on that charming, sacred and eternal breast of that celestial, celestial, mountain, the assembled Rishis no longer saw the ghostly beings who associate with Mahadeva.

sa: यावत् तस्य भवेत् पुष्टिस्तेजो दीप्तिः पराक्रमः। प्रभावः सन्नतिर्जन्म कृष्णे तन्त्रिगुणं विभो॥
en: The advancement or greatness, energy, strength, prowess, power, humility, and family that are in Arjuna can form only a third part of the attributes of Krishna.

sa: ते एव महर्षयः। एवं नातिमहान् कालः स तेषां संन्यवर्तत। कुर्वतां शौचकार्याणि भीष्मस्य निधने तदा॥ महादानानि विप्रेभ्यो ददतामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। भीष्मकर्णपुरोगाणां कुरूणां कुरुसत्तम॥ सहितो धृतराष्ट्रेण स ददावौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। ततो दत्त्वा बहुधनं विप्रेभ्यः पाण्डवर्षभः॥ धृतराष्ट्रं पुरस्कृत्य विवेश गजसाह्वयम्। स समाश्वास्य पितरं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। अन्वशाद् वै स धर्मात्मा पृथिवीं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: And the Pandavas then on account of the death of Bhishma, were engaged in celebrating his funeral ceremonies. And their tine, while thus engaged, seemed too long in passing, and performing the last rites for the bodies of Bhishma, Karna and other foremost Kauravas, they gave away large presents to Brahmanas. And then the foremost descendants of Kuru, again performed with Dhritarashtra the funeral rites, and having distributed profusc riches amongst the Brahmanas, the Pandava chief with Dhritarashtra in advance, entered the city of Hastinapur, and consoling his uncle, having eyes of wisdom, that virtuous prince continued to govern the earth with his brothers.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुन्त्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवा राजसत्तम। वीडिताः संन्यवर्तन्त पाञ्चाल्या सहिताऽनघाः॥
en: Hearing these words of Kunti, the sinless Pandavas, O best of kings, became ashamed. They, therefore, desisted, along with the princess of Panchala, from following her.

sa: नहुष उवाच ब्रवीतु भगवान् मूल्यं महर्षेः सदृशं भृगोः। परित्रायस्व मामस्मद्विषयं च कुलं च मे॥
en: Nahusha said Do you, O illustrious one, say what the value is of that great Rishi of Bhrigu's race. O, save me from this terrible difficulty, save my kingdom and save my family

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थे महात्मानौ रेमतुः कृष्णपाण्डवौ। प्रविश्य तां सभां रम्यां विजह्राते च भारत॥
en: And, O Bharata, the great Krishna and the son of Pandu (Dhananjaya) entering the beautiful hall of assembly at Indraprastha, passed their time in great merriment.

sa: स तैः प्रेम्या परिष्वक्तः पूजितश्च यथाविधि॥ धनं चास्मै ददुर्भूरि प्रीयमाणा महारथाः।
en: They all embraced him with great love and honored him duly. And those powerful carwarrior highly pleased with him, made large gifted of wealth to him.

sa: उद्रिक्तं च यदा सत्त्वमूर्ध्वस्रोतोगतं भवेत्। अल्पं तत्र तमो ज्ञेयं रजश्चाल्पतरं तथा॥
en: There where Goodness predominates in creatures of upward course, Ignorance should be known to exist in a small measure, and Darkness in a still lesser quantity.

sa: ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च लघुत्वं मनसश्च ते। विकुर्वते महात्मानो देवास्त्रिदिवगा इव॥
en: The power of governing everything, selfcontrol, minuteness, these great ones make by operations of their own mind, like the gods themselves living in the celestial region.

sa: राज्यस्थया तपस्तप्तुं कर्तुं दानव्रतं महत्। अनया शक्यमेवाद्य श्रूयतां च वचो मम॥
en: Living in the enjoyment of sovereignty, she is capable of practicing penances and observing the great vow of gifts. Let her, therefore, listen to my words.

sa: रसाभियुक्तमन्नं वा दिवा स्वप्नं च सेवते। अपक्वानागते काले स्वयं दोषान् प्रकोपयेत्॥
en: Or, he taken juicy food or indulges in sleep during daytime. Food that is not properly digested, of itself excites the faults, when the times comes.

sa: धर्मपुत्रे हि धर्मज्ञे कृतज्ञे सत्यवादिनि। सत्यं धर्मो मतीश्चाग्र्या स्थितिश्च सततं स्थिरा॥
en: That son of Dharma honours truth, and is grateful and virtuous, therefore will his virtue, and good sense and the stability of his power always endure.

sa: तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान्। तदेतत् सर्वमाचक्ष्व न हि तृप्यामि कथ्यताम्॥
en: We are desirous of determining the truth. You, indeed, are our eyes. Do you explain this to us. I am never satiated vith listening to you.

sa: शुक्रं शोणितसंसृष्टं स्त्रिया गर्भाशयं गतम्। क्षेत्रं कर्मजमाप्नोति शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्॥
en: The vital seed, mixed with blood, enters the womb of females and becomes the held (of the Individual Soul), good or bad, born of (his) deeds.

sa: तस्माद् ब्रवीमि पार्थ त्वां स्त्रियो रक्ष्याः सदैव च। उभयं दृश्यते तासु सततं साध्वसाधु च॥
en: I therefore, recite it to you. Women should always be protected by you. Amongst them both kinds are to be seen, that is those who are virtuous and those who are not so.

sa: घ्राण जिह्वा च चक्षुश्च वाङ्मनो बुद्धिरेव च। न शब्दानधिगच्छन्ति श्रोत्रं तानधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the tongue, the eye, the skin, the mind, and the understanding, never succeed in apprehending sounds. It is the ear alone which apprehends them.

sa: ततः समाने प्रतितिष्ठतीह इत्येव पूर्वं प्रजजल्प वाणी। तस्मान्मनः स्थावरत्वाद् विशिष्टं तथा देवी जङ्गमत्वाद् विशिष्टा॥
en: After that, she lives in Samana. Even thus did Word formerly speak. Hence Mind, on account of being immovable, is distinguished, and the goddess Word, on account of being movable, is also distinguished.

sa: नैव शक्या गुणा वक्तुं पृथक्त्वेनैव सर्वशः। अविच्छिन्नानि दृश्यन्ते रजः सत्त्वं तमस्तथा॥
en: The qualities are incapable of being described as completely separate from one another. Darkness and Goodness and Ignorance are seen existing in a state of union.

sa: नवम्यां कुर्वतः श्राद्धं भवत्येकशफं बहु। विवर्धन्ते तु दशमी गावः श्राद्धान् विकुर्वतः॥
en: By performing it on the ninth day, one, acquires many animals of uncloven hoofs. By performing it on the tenth day, one acquires many valuable kine.

sa: सुवर्णस्य च दातारो गवां च भरतर्षभ। यानानां वाहनानां च नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who make gifts of gold and of kine, O foremost of Bharata's race, as also of conveyances and animals, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: यद् विशस्ताः कुरुश्रेष्ठ राजानश्च सहस्रशः॥ सर्वं दैवकृतं विद्धि कोऽत्र किं वक्तुमर्हति।
en: The destruction of those for-most ones of Kuru's race and of kings by thousands know, was engendered by Destiny. Who can say anything else in this.

sa: प्रसादाद् भृगुमुख्यस्य किमन्यत्र तपोबलात्॥ तपसा तदवाप्यं हि यत् तु शक्यं मनोरथैः।
en: All this is due to the favour of Bhrigu's son and the power of his penances. By penances one attains all which cherishes in his imagination.

sa: धर्मकामाश्च राज्ञां हि विषये येषामवसीदन्ति साधवः। हीनास्ते स्वगुणैः सर्वैः प्रेत्य चोन्मार्गगामिनः॥
en: Those kings in whose kingdoms good men languish are considered as bereft of the virtues of their order. Hereafter they have to go into wrong paths.

sa: देवतासुरमर्येषु यत् पवित्रं परं स्मृतम्। चण्डालयोनौ जातेन न तत् प्राप्यं कथंचन॥
en: One born as a Chandala can never acquire that dignity which is considered as the most sacred among the celestials and Asuras and human beings. once

sa: राजन् वाक्यं जनस्यास्य मयि सर्वं समर्पितम्। वक्ष्यामि तदहं वीर तज्जुषस्व नराधिप॥
en: O monarch, the answer of this assembly has been committed to my care. I shall speak it out, O hero! Do you receive it, O king.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच भवन्तं कथयित्वा तु मम देवर्षिसत्तमः। ततो मामभ्यनुज्ञाय प्रविष्टो हव्यवाहनम्॥
en: Marutta said That king of celestial saints (Narada) having given me this information about you, and commended me to your care, has entered into the fire.

sa: अहं च प्रीयमाणेन त्वया देवकिनन्दन। यदुक्तस्तत् करिष्यामि न हि मेऽत्र विचारणा॥
en: I shall accomplish all that which, O son of Devaki, pleased with me you have declared to myself. I do not entertain any doubt in this.

sa: सोवर्धत तदा राम रावणान्तःपुरे शुभे ॥ रक्ष्यमाणो वरस्त्रीभिश्छन्नः काष्ठैरिवानलः। मातापित्रोर्हहाहर्ष जनयन्रावणात्मजः॥
en: O Rāma, remaining hidden like a fire by fuel, Ravana's son, rejoicing (the bosoms of) his father and mother, grew up in Rāvana's elegant inner apartments.

sa: स पुत्रवधसंतप्तः क्रूरः क्रोधवशं गतः। समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या सीतां हन्तुं व्यवस्यत॥
en: Burning (in grief) for the destruction of his son, the fell Råvana. coming under the influence of anger, reflection (in his mind), resolved to slay Sīta.

sa: रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्यैव सर्वेषां च वनौकसाम्। विक्रमा निष्फलाः सर्वे यथा शरदि तोयदाः॥
